thread:
laura_sales: Heads-up MerchantCorp POC — they want a committed plan. Target is ~2k QPS sustained for chat, 99th p95 < 120ms. Asking for recommended reserved GPU sizing + autoscale + a preheat/runbook. Any blockers (KMS, VPC, AZ preferences)?

ishaan_se: Quick back-of-envelope: with our 13B quantized baseline, realistic sustained per-GPU throughput ~350–450 RPS depending on batch and seq len. For 2k QPS steady we should reserve ~6 GPUs as minimum, but recommend 8 to hit p95 headroom and handle variance. Add +2 burst for spikes. KV cache warmup will materially cut p95 for returning sessions.

james_soleng: +1. Proposal: Dedicated pool 8 GPUs (reserve), autoscale min=8 max=12, burst credits to allow +4 for 15m. Preheat: KV prefill from sample dialogs + a warmup generator that replays top 2k prompts over 30–45m. Also include a fallback model path to avoid outages on eviction.

maria_sre: Ops notes: spread reserved replicas across 2 AZs for failover and predictable latency. Do NOT use spot for reserved pool. Eviction fallback should be automatic routing to a cheaper model (llama2-7b-quant) with throttled responses rather than errors. Example config snippet for the POC: 

```json
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_replicas": 8,
    "max_replicas": 12,
    "scale_metric": "qps",
    "target_qps_per_replica": 250
  },
  "fallback_models": ["llama2-7b-quantized"],
  "prewarm": {
    "kv_prefill": true,
    "prefill_ratio": 0.6,
    "window_mins": 30
  }
}
```

ishaan_se: Cost note for presales: reserved 8x A100-equivalent monthly commit estimate and burst credit pricing. I'll produce a line-item estimate for laura. Also check MerchantCorp wants customer-managed KMS/HSM for encryption — confirm Private or Dedicated KMS options.

laura_sales: MerchantCorp is OK to commit if we document SLOs, rollback/runbook, and KMS support. They asked for a canary rollout guardrail too — they want to be able to validate model quality and latency before full traffic.

james_soleng: We'll configure a canary route: 5% traffic for 10m -> monitor p95 and error_rate. Rollback triggers: p95>150ms or error_rate>1%. I'll draft the rollout snippet and runbook.

deploy-bot: [artifact] load-test results uploaded: s3://redwood-deals/merchantcorp/2026-04-12/stress-2026-04-12.log (summary: peak simulated 2.4k qps, sustained 2k for 60m, median latency 60ms, p95 110ms on 8 reserved + 2 burst)

maria_sre: Action items: james -> runbook + canary policy; ishaan -> cost + commit sizing note; laura -> confirm KMS/HSM and preheat windows with MerchantCorp; maria -> implement AZ spread & fallback config in staging and validate eviction behavior. Sync Thursday 10:00am PT.

laura_sales: Great — I'll update the deal doc and ping MerchantCorp security for the questionnaire. Thanks team :thumbsup:
